tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page background everywhere — marketing and app: Paper, the brand's own off-white, never pure white. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `ink-subtle` all read on it.

tokens.name: canvas-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating marketing band when two off-white sections meet. Use instead of a border to separate stacked sections.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals, popovers — every raised container that sits on `canvas`. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `ink-subtle` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells inside a `surface`: input fills, table headers, inline code chips, the track of a toggle. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-forest
tokens.usage: The dark block (the name is older than the colour): the app sidebar, the create page's bar, the footer. Use `ink-inverse` and `ink-inverse-muted` on it. Never a page's ground.

tokens.name: surface-forest-deep
tokens.usage: The darkest surface: console body and log viewers. Use `ink-console` and `ink-console-muted` on it.

tokens.name: surface-sand
tokens.usage: Stone, as `surface-sunken`: a block set down on Paper, such as a plan card or a picked choice. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-skeleton
tokens.usage: Placeholder bars while content loads. Decorative only — never carries text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Gradient or flat overlay laid over Minecraft photography so `ink-inverse` headlines clear 4.5:1. Required under any text on an image.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind modals and sheets. Pairs with `shadow-modal`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on `canvas`, `canvas-alt`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `surface-sand`. Also the label on an outline button.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy and secondary text on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `surface-sand`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: The quietest legible text — captions, metadata, placeholder text — on `canvas`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`. Never go lighter than this for text.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `surface-forest`, `forest`, `danger` and over `scrim`.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-forest` and over `scrim`.

tokens.name: ink-on-grass
tokens.usage: The label and icon on any `grass` fill (Ink, the name is older than the colour): primary buttons, the Join action, and the focus ring drawn on that fill.

tokens.name: ink-console
tokens.usage: Console and log body text on `surface-forest-deep`.

tokens.name: ink-console-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps and line numbers in the console, on `surface-forest-deep`.

tokens.name: grass
tokens.usage: The primary action fill, Ink — one per screen. A block that stands 3px proud of its edge and goes down onto it when pressed. Always carries `ink-on-grass`.

tokens.name: grass-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of a `grass` fill.

tokens.name: grass-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a `grass` fill.

tokens.name: grass-soft
tokens.usage: Stone behind a selected mod, a picked choice, an active nav item, or a success note. Carries `forest-ink`.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Solid secondary button, a step softer than Ink. Carries `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: forest-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of a `forest` fill.

tokens.name: forest-ink
tokens.usage: Links and emphasised text on `canvas`, `surface` and `grass-soft`: Ink. Nothing in the product sets coloured type.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and the outline of a resting card on `canvas`. Decorative — never the sole indicator of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The border of an interactive control — input, select, secondary button — on `canvas` and `surface`. Clears 3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: border-inverse
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers on `surface-forest` and `surface-forest-deep`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring on controls sitting on `canvas`, `surface` or `surface-sunken`. Solid, never a glow.

tokens.name: focus-ring-inverse
tokens.usage: The focus ring on controls sitting on `surface-forest`, `surface-forest-deep` or an image. On a `grass` fill the ring is `ink-on-grass` instead.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: The unfilled part of a `ProvisioningPanel` bar, so the `grass` fill clears 3:1 against it in both themes. Always drawn with a `border-strong` hairline so the track's extent is visible too.

tokens.name: status-online
tokens.usage: The dot and label of a server that is Online. On `status-online-soft` and on `surface`. Always paired with the word.

tokens.name: status-online-soft
tokens.usage: Pill background behind `status-online`.

tokens.name: status-starting
tokens.usage: The dot and label for Starting, Provisioning, Restarting and Backing up. On `status-starting-soft` and on `surface`.

tokens.name: status-starting-soft
tokens.usage: Pill background behind `status-starting`.

tokens.name: status-offline
tokens.usage: The dot and label for Stopped, Sleeping and Not set up. On `status-offline-soft` and on `surface`.

tokens.name: status-offline-soft
tokens.usage: Pill background behind `status-offline`.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: The dot and label for Crashed, Suspended and Failed, and inline error text under an input. On `status-danger-soft` and on `surface`.

tokens.name: status-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Pill background behind `status-danger`, and the fill of a Danger zone panel.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: The dot and label for informational notes — version available, scheduled maintenance. On `status-info-soft` and on `surface`.

tokens.name: status-info-soft
tokens.usage: Pill background behind `status-info`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: The fill of a confirmed destructive button — Delete server, Wipe world. Carries `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Decorative only — sunset accent drawn from the brand photography, used in cover art and marketing shapes. Never text, never a status.

tokens.name: lake
tokens.usage: Decorative only — water accent drawn from the brand photography, used in cover art and marketing shapes. Never text, never a status.

tokens.name: status-sleeping
tokens.usage: Asleep: the night field, deep enough to read as text.

tokens.name: status-sleeping-soft
tokens.usage: The fill behind a sleeping status.

tokens.name: dusk
tokens.usage: The button that wakes a sleeping world: the night field as a fill.

tokens.name: dusk-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for `dusk`.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Work in flight: a button that is busy doing what was asked.

tokens.name: amber-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for `amber`.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-2xl
styles.sample: A Minecraft server that starts when your friends join
styles.usage: The marketing hero headline at 1024px and up. Two or three words a line, never more than three lines.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero headline below 1024px, and section openers on marketing pages.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Marketing section headings, and the hero headline on phones.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Page title at the top of an app screen, and the headline inside a full-screen flow step.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Server name on the overview screen, modal titles at the large size.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Card group headings, modal titles, the headline of an empty state.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Card titles — a mod name, a server name in the directory, a settings section.

styles.name: heading-xs
styles.usage: Row titles in dense lists: a player name, a backup entry.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Marketing body copy under a hero or section heading. Hold it to three lines.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body text everywhere in the app, and the value in a settings row.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Supporting copy: card descriptions, help text under an input, list metadata.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, input labels, tab labels, nav items.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Badge and status-pill text, and the label on a floating marketing card.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The one place Blockly sets type in caps: a short kicker above a marketing section heading. Never in the app.

styles.name: mono-md
styles.usage: Server address and other values people copy, on `surface-sunken`.

styles.name: mono-xs
styles.usage: Version numbers and seeds inside badges and table cells.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Everything from icon gaps to section rhythm comes from this scale; nothing in Blockly uses an off-scale gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a status dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and a label; between stacked badges.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Input padding block; gap between a card title and its description.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a list; padding of a compact card.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Padding of a standard card; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Padding of a large card or modal; page gutter on tablets.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Gap between an app screen's header and its content.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; padding of a marketing panel.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a marketing section.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Section rhythm on marketing pages at tablet width.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Section rhythm on marketing pages at desktop width.

tokens.name: space-128
tokens.usage: Space above and below a page's closing call to action.

tokens.name: space-160
tokens.usage: The largest breath — only between the hero and the first section on the landing page.

radius.note: Nothing is rounded: the product is drawn on the same grid as the landing page, where corners are square. The names stay so components keep their roles.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, status pills, checkboxes, mod icons, player faces.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, small buttons, table cells with a fill.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Standard buttons, list rows, inline notes, floating marketing cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards — mod cards, server cards, settings panels, modals.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large containers: the console surface, a marketing feature panel, a dashboard column.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The hero image surface and full-bleed marketing blocks. The signature Blockly corner.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, tab indicators, the Join action: square, like everything else.

shadow.note: Shadows are hard and Ink: a 2px edge, and for what floats a block of shadow down and to the right. Never blurred. A card on `canvas` gets `shadow-card` or a `border` — never both.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A resting card on `canvas`.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: A card floating over a picture, a dropdown, a hovered card.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and sheets above `backdrop`.

layout.note: Gutters and widths. The landing page and the app share the gutter scale so the two feel like one product.

tokens.name: gutter-sm
tokens.usage: Page gutter below 640px.

tokens.name: gutter-md
tokens.usage: Page gutter from 640px to 1023px.

tokens.name: gutter-lg
tokens.usage: Page gutter at 1024px and up, on marketing and in the app.

tokens.name: width-page
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the whole page shell, gutters included.

tokens.name: width-content
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a marketing content column inside the gutters.

tokens.name: width-prose
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a long text block — docs, changelog, legal.

tokens.name: width-copy
tokens.usage: Maximum width of hero body copy and empty-state copy.

tokens.name: width-form
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a settings form column or a creation-flow step.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Marketing top navigation height.

tokens.name: app-topbar
tokens.usage: App top bar height.

tokens.name: app-sidebar
tokens.usage: App sidebar width at 1024px and up.
